name: Constrained Laplacian Fairing
definition: A mesh fairing method inspired by Laplacian smoothing that replaces vertices with centroids of incident face centers, constrained to remain within their initial dual-grid cell to bound error.
summary: Constrained Laplacian Fairing is a mesh smoothing technique that reduces geometric noise while strictly bounding positional error by restricting vertex movement to its originating dual-grid cell.
